transcript.answer: No, not any more. PR #2463 (merged 2026-10-02) added `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, which ran the context evals every night at 03:17 UTC and could also be started by hand. PR #2823 (merged 2026-10-19) deleted that workflow, so nothing runs the evals on a schedule now. The stated reason was that the evals are experiments a person runs and writes up, and the unattended run had gone red three nights in a row on a single `demo-factory-todo` document. They are now run by hand from a developer machine with `node scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` against the deployed lore-api. ADR-010 was amended on 2026-10-27 to say the same.

judgements.reason: The answer says no and that the evals ran nightly from 2026-10-02 (#2463), which matches the truncated gold answer; the extra details about the removal do not contradict it.
